# Outbridge Inc

> Outbridge Inc places vetted virtual assistants, customer support agents, sales reps, and full BPO teams — secure, multilingual (English, French, Spanish, Mandarin, Urdu, Hindi, Arabic), and aligned to US & EU business hours.

Outbridge Inc is an outsourcing / business-process-outsourcing (BPO) firm based in Santa Clara, California. It recruits, vets, and manages remote talent for growing companies, covering virtual assistance, customer support, outbound and inbound sales, and end-to-end back-office operations. Teams work in clients' time zones and languages. Contact: hello@outbridgeinc.com.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://outbridgeinc.com/): Outsourced virtual assistants, customer support, sales, and BPO teams.
- [Services](https://outbridgeinc.com/services): Virtual assistants, customer support, sales agents, and full BPO.
- [About](https://outbridgeinc.com/about): Santa Clara-based outsourcing firm; vetting, security, and multilingual coverage.
- [Contact](https://outbridgeinc.com/contact): Book a free consultation to hire a team; reply within one business day.
- [Careers](https://outbridgeinc.com/careers): Remote consultant, VA, support, sales, and BPO roles.
- [Compliance](https://outbridgeinc.com/compliance): Confidentiality, data security, and compliance practices.
- [Newsletter](https://outbridgeinc.com/newsletter): Practical playbooks on outsourcing and building offshore teams.

## Services
- Virtual Assistants — vetted remote assistants for admin, scheduling, and operations.
- Customer Support Outsourcing — inbound support across chat, email, and phone.
- Outsourced Sales Agents — outbound and inbound sales development reps.
- Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) — full back-office teams and managed processes.

- Headquarters: Santa Clara, California, USA.
- Languages supported: English, French, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Urdu, Hindi, Arabic.
- Coverage: aligned to United States and European Union business hours; serves US, EU, and UK.
